definition: An implicit measure is a way of assessing automatic associations indirectly, usually by examining how quickly and accurately a person sorts stimuli rather than relying on direct self-report. In this source, it refers to an Implicit Association Test used to capture underlying response-latency patterns linked to semantic associations.
